title: From Zero to OCR: A Data-Centric Framework for Unsupported Low-Resource Scripts
abstract: arXiv:2611.00078v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optical character recognition (OCR) remains inaccessible to many low-resource scripts because annotated document images are unavailable and synthetic training data can fail to preserve script-specific visual structure. We present a data-centric framework that builds end-to-end OCR for such scripts from only an unannotated text corpus and digital fonts, without manually annotating a single training image. A synthetic data engine renders word, line and page images with correct complex-script shaping and automatically derived labels; a YOLOv8 word detector and a convolutional recurrent recognizer trained with connectionist temporal classification learn from these images; and a stage-gate evaluation protocol isolates recognition error before detection is introduced. translated_title: 从零到OCR：面向无支持低资源文字的数据中心框架
translated_abstract: 光学字符识别（OCR）对许多低资源文字而言仍然难以获得，因为标注的文档图像不可用，而合成训练数据又可能无法保留文字特有的视觉结构。我们提出了一个以数据为中心的框架，仅需一个未标注的文本语料库和数字字体，即可为这类文字构建端到端的OCR系统，而无需人工标注任何一张训练图像。该框架包含一个合成数据引擎，用于渲染具有正确复杂文字整形和自动推导标签的单词、行与页面图像；一个YOLOv8单词检测器和一个采用连接主义时间分类（CTC）训练的卷积循环识别器从这些图像中学习；此外还有一个分阶段门控评估协议，可在引入检测之前单独隔离识别误差。我们在克什米尔语上验证了该框架——这是一种使用波斯-阿拉伯纳斯塔利格（Nastaliq）文字的语言，约有680万使用者，而六种广泛使用的OCR引擎均不支持它。三行-l……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个以数据为中心的框架，仅需未标注文本语料库和数字字体、无需人工标注任何图像，即可为六种主流OCR引擎均不支持的克什米尔语纳斯塔利格文字等低资源文字构建端到端OCR系统。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a data-centric framework that builds end-to-end OCR for unsupported low-resource scripts, such as Kashmiri Nastaliq which none of six widely used OCR engines supports, using only an unannotated text corpus and digital fonts without manually annotating a single training image.
